description: PNG of a screen, a mockup variant (mockup + variant) or a node. node takes a full ref alone (<screen>.<id>, mockup:<name>#<variant>.<id>, component:/pattern: ref): the screen or mockup is derived, a contradicting screen/mockup/variant fails validation_failed, and the capture clips to that element (+8px). Mockup: width sets the viewport (default 390), full-page. scale 1-3 (default 1). browser re-renders in another installed engine.
name: get_screenshot
